description: [Read · free] Look up a company saved in Flux by exactly one of name (case-insensitive exact match), linkedin_url, linkedin_company_id (LinkedIn's numeric id) or company_id, free. Returns company_id, linkedin_company_id, name, linkedin_url, page_type and coverage for you: connected_people_current (people connected to you, meaning they engaged with posts you can see, are in your campaigns or segments, or you pulled or enriched them, who hold a current position there) and engagers_current (those of them who engaged with your posts, with their engagement total). A name shared by several saved companies returns `candidates` to pick from. A company that is not saved returns _meta.next_step = linkedin_company_info (1 credit), which saves it. Generic placeholders (Self-employed, Freelance, Stealth...) are refused. Pure DB read, no LinkedIn pull, 0 credits.

linkedin_company_id.description: LinkedIn's numeric company id, as linkedin_company_info returns it
